_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "sale_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "purchase_price" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "hsn_code" TEXT NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "stock_qty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "qty_delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "business_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "shop_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "owner_name" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "invoice_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "invoice_next_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "linked_supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "account_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "customer_name" TEXT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "discount_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "original_unit_cost" INTEGER NULL, "cost_corrected_at" INTEGER NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "replaced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "linked_customer_id" TEXT NULL, "balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "supplier_name" TEXT NULL, "supplier_bill_no" TEXT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "discount_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount_paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "bill_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES bills (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "purchase_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_revisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "replaced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "to_method" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_states" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_run_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ok" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("ok" IN (0, 1)), "detail" TEXT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_movements_item ON stock_movements (item_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_movements_source ON stock_movements (source_type, source_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_account ON ledger_entries (account_type, account_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_ledger_source ON ledger_entries (source_type, source_id)
